tagline: Pure holding company controlling 50.005% of Heineken N.V., providing strategic oversight and stability to the HEINEKEN group without direct operational activities
hero_kpi_rationale: Heineken Holding N.V. holds exactly 50.005% of the shares in Heineken N.V., ensuring decisive control over the HEINEKEN group despite the absence of direct operational activities. This unique stake defines the group's governance structure.

risks.title: Structural dependence on Heineken N.V.
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk mentioned upfront: Heineken Holding N.V. has no operational activities, only distributes dividends received from Heineken N.V., and employs no staff. Central in Item 1A, explicit language on total dependence, stable but structural trend, critical weight for the holding's viability.

risks.title: Absence of internal risk management system
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly stated: « Heineken Holding N.V., unlike Heineken N.V., does not have an internal risk management and control system ». Mentioned twice in Item 1A, direct and unambiguous language, stable trend by structural design, high weight for governance.

risks.title: Shareholder concentration and control risk
risks.score_rationale: Mrs C.L. de Carvalho-Heineken holds 52.01% of the capital (including L'Arche Holding S.A. at 50.005%), creating extreme concentration. Explicitly mentioned with precise data, neutral language but revealing figures, stable trend since 2006, major weight for governance and minority rights.

risks.title: Voting restrictions and limited shareholder rights
risks.score_rationale: Voting rights restriction agreement applies to a specific shareholder if its stake exceeds 20% of the capital or 20% economic interest in Heineken N.V. Mentioned in section « Restrictions related to shares », technical language but significant impact, stable trend, moderate weight for minority shareholders.

risks.title: Single-tier governance with partial non-compliance
risks.score_rationale: One-tier structure implemented in 2012 with formal non-application of best-practice provisions III.8.1 and III.8.4 of the Code. Justification: former executive members cannot serve as chairman or independent directors. Explicitly mentioned with references to the Code, technical language but reveals intentional deviation, stable trend since 2012, moderate weight for compliance.

risks.title: Risk of change of control and required approval
risks.score_rationale: Any material change in the nature or identity of the company requires approval from the meeting of priority shareholders AND the General Meeting. Mentioned in section « Board of Directors' resolutions », explicit language listing cases (transfer of business, long-term collaborations, acquisitions), stable trend, moderate weight for major transactions.

risks.title: Dependence on priority shareholders for governance
risks.score_rationale: The 250 priority shares (0.01% of capital) held by two foundations (Stichting Administratiekantoor Priores and Stichting Beheer Prioriteitsaandelen) have the right to propose a non-binding list of candidates for each Board appointment. Mentioned in section « Priority shares », technical language, stable trend since inception, low but symbolic weight for governance.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, technological innovation, or advanced digitalization in the 2016 annual report. The company has no direct operational activity and focuses solely on shareholding.
evidence: No reference to AI or emerging technologies
